QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Refined Living
QuestInfo.0: Glimmer Man wants to ask a personal favor of you. See what it could be.
QuestInfo.1: Glimmer Man asks you to acquire some Refined Lianium, saying that he became curious about what the Cerberusians were after. He says he wants to get his hands on some before anyone else...
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Refined Lianium to Glimmer Man.

item.0: If you happen to come across some Refined Lianium, would you bring it to me?
